items.name: ABCDE-2200 Five-Layer
items.role: The line starts here — resin is melted and blown into a 5-layer co-extruded film, 2100 mm wide.

items.name: AI-6C CI Flexo Press
items.role: The blown film is printed in up to 6 colours on the central-impression drum at 260 m/min.

items.name: T-PRO Heat-Seal Machine
items.role: Printed film is sealed and cut into finished bags across multiple lanes at production speed.

items.name: CX-RGB Roll Bag Machine
items.role: Bags are perforated and wound onto rolls with automatic core cutting for retail-ready packs.

items.name: CX Pelletizing Line
items.role: Edge trim and scrap from every stage return here — recovered into resin and fed back to step 01.
